app_documentation:
The Hospital Appointment Booking System is a comprehensive digital healthcare platform designed to streamline the appointment scheduling process between patients and medical professionals. This modern, patient-centric application serves as a bridge connecting patients seeking medical care with available doctors across various specialties, eliminating traditional phone-based booking inefficiencies and reducing administrative overhead. The system is built on a robust technology stack utilizing React for the frontend, Node.js with Express for the backend, TypeScript for type safety, and PostgreSQL for reliable data management, ensuring scalability and maintainability across both web and mobile platforms.

The application's core functionality revolves around five primary features that address the complete appointment lifecycle. Patients can register and manage their accounts with personal and medical information, search for doctors by specialty or availability, and book appointments through an intuitive interface displaying real-time time slot availability. Doctors benefit from powerful availability management tools that allow them to set recurring weekly schedules, block specific time slots, and view their daily appointments in both list and calendar formats. The system also includes comprehensive appointment management capabilities, enabling both patients and doctors to view, reschedule, or cancel appointments with appropriate notifications, along with an automated notification system that sends timely reminders and confirmations via email to reduce no-shows and keep all parties informed.

The platform serves three distinct user roles: patients who need to book and manage their medical appointments, doctors who need to manage their schedules and view patient information, and administrators who oversee the entire system with full access to user and appointment management. The design prioritizes accessibility and ease of use with a clean medical aesthetic featuring calming blue color schemes, clear visual hierarchy, and touch-friendly components suitable for users of all ages and technical abilities. The responsive design adapts seamlessly from mobile devices to tablets and desktop computers, ensuring consistent user experience across all platforms.

Built with security and compliance in mind, the system implements JWT-based authentication, secure password hashing, and role-based access control to protect sensitive patient information. The database schema is carefully designed to maintain data integrity through proper relationships and constraints, while supporting efficient queries through strategic indexing. The MVP sprint focuses on delivering core booking functionality with plans for future enhancements including SMS notifications, advanced search filters, telemedicine integration, and comprehensive reporting dashboards for healthcare administrators.

glossary.Appointment Slot: A specific 30-minute time block during which a doctor is available to see a patient. Slots are created based on doctor availability settings and can be in states of available, booked, or blocked.
glossary.Availability Pattern: A recurring weekly schedule set by doctors that defines their working hours for each day of the week. Patterns include start time, end time, and day of week, and can be toggled on or off to manage time slots.
glossary.Patient Profile: A comprehensive record containing a patient's personal information (name, email, phone, date of birth, address) and medical history, linked to their user account and used for appointment booking and medical record keeping.
glossary.Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): A security mechanism that restricts system access and functionality based on user roles (patient, doctor, administrator), ensuring users can only perform actions appropriate to their role.
glossary.Time Slot Conflict: A scheduling error that occurs when multiple booking requests target the same doctor and time slot simultaneously, prevented through database-level validation and transaction locking mechanisms.
glossary.Notification Type: A classification of automated messages sent to users, including appointment reminders (sent 24 hours before), confirmations (sent immediately after booking), and cancellations (sent when appointments are cancelled or rescheduled).
